content: Each utterance in the seed data is categorized according to Table TABREF14 and then abstracted into templates by replacing entity phrases like cough and often with respective placeholders “#symptom#” and “#frequency#”. The templates are refined through verifying logical correctness and injecting expression diversity by linguistically trained researchers. As these replacements do not alter the syntactic structure, we interchange such placeholders with various verbal expressions to enlarge the simulated training set in Section SECREF20 . Clinical validation was also conducted by certified telehealth nurses.
